verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an API reference section (api-reference/introduction) and endpoint-level docs such as POST /agent/{agent_id}/extraction-categories. It also has an API quickstart that walks through placing a real call and fetching the transcript, which counts as followable examples. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive 'try it' playground, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404, so interactivity is unsupported. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable request examples embedded in the reference, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
